Immerse yourself in the serene and meditative world of Indian classical music with this enchanting performance of Night Ragas by three legendary maestros: Pt. Hariprasad Chaurasia, Prog. V. Jog., Ustad Bismillah Khan.
Credits:
Song: Holi Misra Kafi
Artist: Pt. Hariprasad Chaurasia, Prog. V. Jog
Music Director: Traditional
Lyricist: Traditional
Song: Bageshri Teen Tal
Artist: Ustad Bismillah Khan
